programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 4, Finland
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 5, Bulgaria
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 6, Latvia
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 7, Croatia
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 8, Poland
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 9, Austria
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 10, Romania
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 11, World Log Lift Championship
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 12, Lithuania
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 13, Portugal
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 14, Martinique
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 15, Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 16, World Finals Turkey
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 1, Norway - World strongest Viking
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 3, Lithuania - Log lift World championship
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 5, Latvia
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 6, Serbia
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 7, Bulgaria
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 8, England
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 9, Finland
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 10, Finland - World championship under 105 kilograms
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 11, Romania Part 1
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 12, Romania Part 2
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 13, Curacao
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 14, Portugal
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 15, Dubai World grand finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 16, Dubai World grand finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 3, Lithuania
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 5, Serbia
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 6, Canada (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 12, Curacao
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 13, Jordan
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 14, Greece
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 2, Germany - FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 3, Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 6, Finland
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 1, World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL S6 Ep2 FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 3, Turkey
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 6, Russia
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 10, Portugal
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 11, Callio
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 12, Ukraine
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 13, Caribbean
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 14, Dubai
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 2, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 3, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 5, Strongest Viking
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 8, Portugal
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 9, World Records (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 10, World Records (Part 2)
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 11, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 1)
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 12, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 2)
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 13, Ukraine
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 14, Romania
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 1, Finland Stage 1
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 2, Holland Part 1
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 3, Holland Part 2
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 4, Serbia Part 1
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 5, Serbia Part 2
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 6, Joensuu Part 1
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 7, Joensuu Part 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 8, Esposende
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep7 - Stockholm
The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.

programme.title: Conquering Your Fears
programme.desc: Norissa doubts herself after missing a shot on an excellent trophy, but recovers her confidence soon after and learns not to judge herself too harshly. PH Marius patiently guides them and helps them build their hunting career and confidence as huntresses. Norissa has to conquer her fear of heights in this episode as Jen tries to convince her to take a leap of faith, by jumping out of an airplane.

programme.title: First Experiences In Africa
programme.desc: After a whirlwind two weeks, Jen and Norissa find themselves in Africa. Not knowing the culture, the animals or their new producer Kappie. Their journey starts with learning how to track these majestic animals in Africa, and Norissa finds herself being pushed out of her comfort zone on the first trip. Follow their journey from the start and see how they grow into experienced and talented huntresses.

programme.title: New Zealand Treasures
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa are heading to New Zealand this week to look for a Thar and a Chamois with their friends from Doddsy's Hunting Experience. Stalking in the open fields and having to take long distance shots are just some of the challenges they'll have to overcome. Norissa will have to push herself to adapt to the ever-changing circumstances that comes with this difficult hunt, and face her fear of heights as Jen tries to convince her to bungee jump off the highest bridge in New Zealand.

programme.title: Northern Cape Surprises
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa travel to the Northern Cape of South Africa to hunt with Wintershoek Safaris. The hunt starts with a laugh as Jen realizes yet again how short she is, especially in comparison to their PH Yvan. This new terrain is challenging and comes with many obstacles during their hunt for a Black Wildebeest and Red Hartebeest. Adrenaline runs high, as Jen has to change tactics in a matter of seconds to get her trophy and Norissa gets a pleasant surprise when lining up to shoot her trophy. The team also journeys to Kimberley Hole, the famous diamond mine in South Africa.

programme.title: Freezing Africa, But Warm Friendships
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa are back at Wintershoek Safaris, in the Northern Cape of South Africa this week. In this episode they are in pursuit of a Gemsbuck and a Springbuck. PH Yvan discovers the ups and downs from hunting with two female hunters and his adrenaline is high as Jen gets in place to take aim on a trophy. They learn a lot of this new area and get to see nature's way of making silk. There is a wounded Buffalo in the area and the team is on high alert as they're very cautious of every noise and movement while tracking one of Norissa's favorite animals, a Gemsbuck. A lot of excitement and adrenalin in this episode!

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: This week Jen and Norissa are back in New Zealand hunting with Doddsy's Hunting Experience. Not having to sit in the office back in CA, is a welcome change for Jen and Norissa as they enjoy the outdoors and physical challenges of this trip. Emotions run high as Norissa tries to take a long distance shot in an uncomfortable position and Jen discovers that harvesting her Chamois trophy might just be half the challenge in this audacious country.

programme.title: The White Mountain
programme.desc: This week Jen and Norissa travel to the Freestate hunting with Witkop Safaris. Their PH and Outfitter Jess de Klerk will be guiding them along with good friend and guest Morgan Mills. Norissa is in persuit of an Eland, but will the big open plains and too many eyes allow her to get into shooting distance. Morgan experiences the value of a one-shot-kill in this action pack episode. Morgan also ventures down an African river-rafting experience.

programme.title: Facing One Of The Dangerous 7
programme.desc: This week Jen and Norissa, along with guest Morgan Mills travel to Zimbabwe, where they will be hunting with Martin Pieters Safaris. Their PH for this trip, Bruce, has his hands full with their first female hunters in camp. Long, hot days and challenging stalks lead to Jen gearing up to take the first of her African Dangerous 7 animals.

programme.title: Scarecrow Stalking
programme.desc: This week Jen and Norissa are back at Wintershoek Safaris, in the Northern Cape of South Africa. Jen is in search of a Springbuck trophy and they visit the Wild Hearts Rehab center. They play with a baby Rhino at the rehab center and Jen almost gets her sunglasses stolen by a monkey. Jen and Norissa learns about tracking animals in Africa and how walking and stalking in these terrains can be very different and amusing.

programme.title: One-Eye Gemsbuck
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa travel to Namibia this week to hunt with Agagia Safaris. They will be hunting in the semi-desert area of South West Africa looking for a Gemsbuck. After an eventful stalk they soon realize it could have been a lot easier. This is a fun week with the team out playing on the sand dunes with ATV's and snowboards. Don't miss this fun and exciting episode.

programme.title: Challenging The Outfitter
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa are still in Namibia with Agagia Safaris this week. After becoming good friends with outfitter and PH Carin Neetling, they challenge her to a hunt; she accepts the challenge and joins Jen and Norissa in pursuit of a Zebra. Later Jen and Norissa experience sea life with an unexpected visit.

programme.title: Darting A Rhino
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa are back at Wintershoek Safaris, this week they will be darting a White Rhino. Due to Rhino pouching green hunts on Rhinos are illegal in South Africa, vita dart safaris are the new green hunt on rhinos, never done before in the Northern Cape of South Africa, Norissa becomes the pioneer for the first vita dart safari in this province. This episode we will talk to the authorities and find out how Rhino vita darting can still generate an income and by doing so help save the Rhino species.

programme.title: Where To Next?
programme.desc: Jen, Norissa and producer Kappie flashback on the adventures they've had so far, how much they've grown and all the highs and lows of their journey so far.

programme.title: Bongo In The Congo pt. 1
programme.desc: The trip begins with last minute changes and unforeseen challenges. From driving through the forest for 25 hours, to 13 hour hunting days, see if Norissa gets her Bongo trophy after an exhausting week.

programme.title: Bongo In The Congo pt. 2
programme.desc: In the previous episode Norissa got her Bongo trophy and now it's Jen's turn. Time is running out, with only 2 days of hunting left, and Jen is feeling the pressure, and the long days are beginning to show its toll on the whole team. Will she get her trophy in time?

programme.title: The Fast And The Furious
programme.desc: Jen, Norissa and guest host Morgan Mills travel to South Africa to hunt at Witkop Safaris, with Outfitter and PH Jess De Klerk.

programme.title: Not So Plains, Plains Game
programme.desc: Jen will be looking for a black springbuck, while Norissa is in pursuit of a red lechwe.

programme.title: Black Buck Tango
programme.desc: Outfitter Alejandro Trigo will be their guide on this trip and guide the team through this new terrain and learning about the animals in this area. Jen also gets a change to learn from SCI master measurer while measuring her own trophy, after doing her measurer course earlier this year. The team also has a good laugh taking a tango lesson in Buenos Aires, embracing everything this adventurous country has to offer.

programme.title: The Argentina Gaucho
programme.desc: Jen is in pursuit of a Red Stag, and Norissa has a surprisingly good morning hunting for her blackbuck.Jen, Norissa and Kappie will also be joining the TGB team in a traditional day rounding up the cattle. Jen reminisces in her memories of her rodeo days, Norissa can't wait to share this with her father in-law and Kappie tries to balance horse and camera.

programme.title: Those Who Hunt Together, Stay Together pt. 1
programme.desc: Norissa and her husband, Brian, will be looking for a Cape Buffalo, but a few other trophies comes along that's just too good to pass on. Jen and her fiancé, Jon, will be bowhunting on this episode, it is Jon's first time in Africa and Jen is enjoying sharing her experiences with him and building new memories together.

programme.title: Texas Red Sheep
programme.desc: Jen, Norissa, and Kappie are back at Morani River Ranch for the first episode of Season 3. Norissa is in pursuit of a Red Sheep, and has some unexpected obstacles to overcome on her quest for her trophy.

programme.title: Those Who Hunt Together, Stay Together pt. 2
programme.desc: Norissa and Brian are still looking for a Cape Buffalo. Jen and Jon are enjoying each others company in the blind, observing some oversize visitors at the waterhole. On this episode Jen and Jon makes it official at an intimate wedding in Red Bluff, California. Join the team for an episode that shows the bonds between friendship and love, and how sharing in experience can strengthen any relationship.

programme.title: Surviving The Blind
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa travel to Pennsylvania for a Whitetail hunt with Quest Haven Outfitters. Patience is a virtue on this hunt. Also, join her on a special hunt where she takes her niece on her first turkey hunt. Teaching the next generation the importance of conservation and hunting is one of Jen's passions.

programme.title: Return To The Jungle
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa reflect back to their time in the Congo while speaking to Jerry at Safari Club International. In 2015, Universal Huntress donated a hunt for conservation in partnership with Congo Hunting Safaris. Jerry bought this hunt and the proceeds went directly to SCI. Jen and Norissa visit with him to share their experiences and their most memorable parts of the trip

programme.title: Serbian Quest
programme.desc: Guest host Kasi Geraci travels to Serbia with outfitter Jess De Klerk from Balkan Venture Safaris. The year before Jen and Norissa visited Jess in South Africa at Witkop Safaris and the team was excited for Kasi to be the first woman from the US to hunt in Serbia. Tune in for this exciting episode, filled with ups and downs as Kasi travels to an unknown country for the first time.

programme.title: A Look Back
programme.desc: Jen and Norissa along with producer Kappie have been on many crazy escapades the past two years! Here's a look back at some fun footage and hunts that didn't make the episodes.

programme.title: King Of The Jungle
programme.desc: Jen travels to South Africa to hunt a male lion with Tollies African Safaris with outfitter and PH Tollie Jordaan. Join her and Norissa for this amazing hunt as she explains why she chose to hunt a lion and the conservation that is so important to the hunting industry.

programme.title: Outside My Comfort Zone
programme.desc: Norissa finds herself traveling to Colorado without Jen on the most challenging hunt of the year. She will be hunting elk with Witherhawk Outfitters in the Flat Tops Wilderness area of Colorado in below Zero temperatures with team GWG member and guide Jessica Amos.

programme.title: African Teacher
programme.desc: We're returning to Tollie's African Safaris for this episode, and it brings back sweet memories for Jen, who just 2 years ago hunted her African Lion with Tollie. Joining us on this trip is our sponsor Lansky Sharpeners CEO, Chris Fire. This is his first time in Africa and Jen is excited to teach him all she's learned from hunting the African Plains.

programme.title: First Time In Africa
programme.desc: We're still at Tollie's African Safaris this week and Norissa is hunting with GWG PR Manager Callie Wolverton. This is Callie's first trip to Africa and her first international trip ever. Norissa is excited to share this opportunity with her as Callie takes her first African animal.

programme.title: Ibex Slam
programme.desc: We're back in Spain with Caza Hispanica, and Jen has to pick herself up after yet another unsuccessful stalk. The traveling and long hours hiking the mountains are starting to take its toll, but with Jen's best friend, Norissa by her side, Jen's not ready to give up.

programme.title: Super Gold
programme.desc: Jen, Norissa and Kappie travel to Valencia Spain for an Ibex hunt with Caza Hispanica with guide and outfitter Vicente Gil. The team will be traveling to several different locations in Spain for their Ibex trophies and experience the local culture, food and challenges that this amazing country has to offer.

programme.title: Halfway To My Ibex Slam
programme.desc: We're back in Spain with Caza Hispanica, and Jen has to pick herself up after yet another unsuccessful stalk. The traveling and long hours hiking the mountains are starting to take its toll, but with Jen's best friend, Norissa by her side, Jen's not ready to give up.

programme.title: Hunters Are Conservationists
programme.desc: On this trip we will be showcasing how hunters are conservationist and what we as a community do for the survival of so many species.

programme.title: Women That Hunt
programme.desc: On this episode Alejandro's wife, Danielle will join the team on a hunt. See how this pregnant huntress does not let anything stop her from participating in this sport that she loves so much. This episode shows the challenges hunters have to face from time to time, and that not getting your trophy does not mean it was an unsuccessful hunt.

programme.title: Texas Dreams
programme.desc: Jen is in pursuit of an Auodad, but it's proving to be a harder challenge than wat she anticipated. Tune in to see if she'll get it before time runs out…

programme.title: Sacrifices
programme.desc: Knowing that their business, Girls with Guns Clothing always comes first, Jen gave up the first half of rifle season to go to business meetings. Jen and Norissa swap places at elk camp in the Flat Top Wilderness and Jen came in the last 4 days to try and harvest a bull elk with her guide and Team GWG member, Jessica Amos.

programme.title: Looking Back On The Season
programme.desc: A recap on the season and what's to come on Season 3.

programme.title: Black Bears and Mosquitos
programme.desc: Jen, Norissa and Kappie travel to Canada for a Black Bear hunt with Journey Hunts. Days go by and neither Jen nor Norissa get a good shot on a black bear. The mosquitos are eating them alive. Norissa and Kappie try to make the best out of the long hours, sitting way to close toether in a tiny tree blind. After 5 days of not seeing any good bears come in, will they go home empty handed?

programme.desc: With Norissa's husband, Brian, with her for support, and making new friends on the way, this is an episode filled with gorgeous trophies and their faith leading them every step of the way.

programme.title: Quest Like No Other - Norissa
programme.desc: With Norissa's husband, Brian, with her for support, and making new friends on the way, this is an episode filled with gorgeous trophies and their faith leading them every step of the way.

programme.desc: Introduction to the Able Outdoors video series for disabled sportsmen and women. Able Outdoors will be a reference for the able sportsman, their family members and the professionals working in all types of therapeutic programs. We want to show people who think they can't that they can. We want to reach those who have been lost and forgotten or been recently injured.

programme.title: A Turkey Hunt Goes South in the Florida Swamp
programme.desc:
Welcome to Season 1, Episode 3 of Seek and Find TV! This episode is all about chasing a turkey through a Florida swamp! Reese and Amber decided to let Scott, guide them through their home turf (aka the swamp) since he's the expert turkey caller, and what happened was a disaster! He found the turkey.... but he also found out how quick things can go south in the swamp! This turkey hunting episode will for sure have you laughing and keep you excited the whole time!
Seek and Find TV was founded by Scott Hinnant of Conviction Outdoors and Reese Richards of Bearded Outdoors. The two friends came together and decided to create an outdoor show with a twist of Jesus. They equally share a love and passion for all things hunting, fishing, and anything in the outdoors, but what really brought these two together is their love for Jesus and passion to spread His name. Scott resides in Mississippi and Reese in Florida, so the episodes for Seek and Find TV will have a good variety of scenery and things to do in the outdoors.
Please let us know if you enjoy watching our episodes and if there is anything specific you'd like us to create. Please be sure to subscribe as well. God Bless!

programme.desc: Host Jana Waller heads to Florida with her T/C Encore single shot in hopes of connecting on her first Osceola. Justin Strickland, owner of Strickly Outdoors wastes no time in introducing Jana to a close- encounter of the bearded kind.

programme.title: The Spotted Hyena Project
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller gets up close and personal with several spotted hyenas in South Africa and learns more about the conservation behind this incredible and often demonized species.

programme.title: In Search of Sharks Teeth
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller combs the beaches of West Florida in search of prehistoric shark teeth.

programme.title: Montana griz encounter
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller encounters a mating pair of grizzlies while searching for spring bears with her buddy Paul Servey.

programme.title: BOWFISHING BONANZA PART II
programme.desc: Jana is back in Texas with AMS Bowfishing's Matt Schillinger. It's an action packed couple of days hunting hogs, turkey, and a giant alligator gar!

programme.title: Bowfishing Zimbabwe Crocodile
programme.desc: One of the coolest shots ever filmed with a bow and arrow. You don't want to miss this exciting Crocodile hunt from Zimbabwe. Follow along as VP of AMS Bowfishing Jeff Braun tucks away in a ground blind and waits patiently for a shot of a lifetime at an African Crocodile. The AMS gear does exactly what its meant to do.

programme.title: Giants in Green Bay
programme.desc: Mathew is joined by Cindy Braun the CEO of AMS Bowfishing as they travel to Green Bay Wisconsin in pursuit of giant common carp. Also known as Title Town USA home of the Green Bay Packers but also giant Carp. Also known for its world class Walleye fishing, these invasive carp must be kept in check as they destroy spawning habitat for the native fish. Non-stop bowfishing action as the Giants of Green Bay move into the shallows and make for some great night time bowfishing.

programme.title: Where The Buffalo Roam Part 1
programme.desc: In this episode Mathew heads down to Kentucky to meet up with Dennis Redden in pursuit of big buffalo. As the suns rays warm up the water temperatures the action picks up and they connect on a giant 74 pounder.

programme.title: Where The Buffalo Roam Part 2
programme.desc: Don't miss the exciting conclusion of Where the Buffalo Roam Part 2. Dennis's grandboys Ty and Cody join on some bowfishing fun and if you thought the 74 pound Buffalo was big in part one, wait until you see. Well you'll just have to watch and find out.

programme.title: Tidal Water Rays Part 1
programme.desc: Mathew heads east to Delaware to chase some stingrays with his good friend Corey Brossman. We will show you the gear we use, the type of sting rays we target, and how to prepare them for the grill.

programme.title: Tidal Water Rays Part 2
programme.desc: Tidal Water Rays Part 2. Now its time to get after those GIANT Butterfly Rays. We put the AMS gear to work as these beast can weigh over 150 pounds and have a wingspan over 5 feet. These Butterfly Rays make for great table fare as we also show how to prepare them for the grill. Plus Collins gets a special gift.

programme.title: Chasin' Grassies
programme.desc: Lets turn back the clock and head south and chase some Grass Carp with our good buddy Dennis Redden.

programme.title: Twisted Limbs
programme.desc: Brody takes out a friend with Twisted Limbs bowfishing in Florida for some amazing bowfishing in both fresh and saltwater

programme.title: East Coast Mixed Bag
programme.desc: The boys hit the east coast waters and get a mixed bag of Rays, Gar, Snakeheads, and Catfish and put the AMS gear to work.

programme.title: The Kids
programme.desc: Its the Kids turn for a little bowfishing fun as we are joined by Garrett, Kayla, and their mother Stephanie Drexler. The kids enjoy some daytime shooting and then get to experience bowfishing under the lights. The action heats up as some giant common carp get a free boat ride and the kids shoot their biggest fish to date.

programme.title: History of the AMS Big 20
programme.desc: Travel back in time with us this week as we relive the trials and tribulations that come with hosting one of the nation's biggest bowfishing tournaments. We navigate through the timeline of a tournament that started down in Brandenburg KY in 2011, with 40 boats participating, to a tournament that now regularly hosts 80+ boats up here in Wisconsin. The AMS Big 20 Challenge is now considered one of the premier events in the bowfishing world. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the roller coaster 13-year journey that has made the tournament what it is today.

programme.title: Calling All Gators
programme.desc: Its Big Game Bowfishing time down on Florida as we hook up with Jana Waller host of Skull Bound Chronicles and Orlando Gator Hunts. We put the gator calls to work as we try to get Alligators to come close enough for a shot. We also explain the AMS Big Game equipment that it takes to successfully harvest an Alligator.

programme.title: Mr. Kentucky 2 – Dennis Redden (Ep. 68)
programme.desc:
This week we sit down with long time AMS Bowfishing family member and owner of Redden Outfitters in Kentucky, Dennis Redden. Dennis recaps his 2023 guiding season and how bowfishing in Kentucky has changed over the years.
We also discuss:
• Biggest learning curve for first time bowfishers
• Dennis' thoughts on Worlds 2024 being held in Kentucky
• Redden family bowfishing memories
• Best days on the water so far in 2023
PLUS!
• What should be the punishment for the loser of AMS Fantasy Football League? (You're going to want to hear this!) ?

programme.title: Silver Carp-Multi Billion Dollar Threat/BAA Prez Christina Hayden (70)
programme.desc: How much money is spent on keeping Silver Carp out of the Great Lakes? You will be shocked plus newly appointed Bowfishing Association of America President Christina Hayden joins us. Its October so get out there and enjoy the outdoors. Its a beautiful time of the year to be on the water or in the woods. It'll put a smile on your face.

programme.title: Nacho Stingrays
programme.desc: Mathew from AMS Bowfishing invites Julie McQueen CEO of Carbon TV and Jana Waller host of Skull Bound Chronicles to the east coast for some bowfishing for Stingray. They meet up with Brossman Boys Bowfishing and Corey Brossman for some exciting tidal water action. Plus they show you how they prepare these rays for the grill. Nacho Stingrays coming right up...Eat them up Yum Yum!

programme.title: Common Fun
programme.desc: Mathew and Derrick head out on the Wisconsin River backwaters in search of spawning Common Carp. With the water temps reaching 65 degrees the fellas get a little giddy when they see whats happening in those backwaters. From the boat to sneaking up on Carp from the bank they sure had some Common Fun.

programme.title: The Hunt For the Giant
programme.desc: The story on how Mat from AMS bowfishing hunted down a GIANT butterfly stingray with his bowfishing gear

programme.title: Heart of a Giant-Brad Jordan
programme.desc: Diagnosed with MOPD Type 2 that effects 1 in 3 million people Brad Jordan stands at 38 inches and weighs 35 pounds and loves everything about the outdoors. At home Brad is not alone as his sister Bridgett stands at 27 inches and they are in the Guinness Book of World Records as the smallest siblings. Brad joins us and uses a crossbow for some amazing bowfishing action as he fills the tub with some big Wisconsin Buffs. Live Life to the Fullest!

programme.title: Texas Slough Surprise Part 1
programme.desc: Mathew and Jana head south to Texas and meet up with Buck Medley and hit up the Texas sloughs for some Longnose Gar. We show you how to fillet them out and deep fry them up for a tasty campfire delight.

programme.title: Texas River Slough Surprise Part 2
programme.desc: Part 2 Texas River Slough Surprise. Mathew and Jana are back on the water in search of Alligator Gar. With no luck on the big water they are down to their final 4 hours of the trip. The cameraman has already flown back home, Buck Medley went back to work, and Mathew and Jana have a plane to catch but decide to give it one more try down in the slough. Mathew finally connects on an Alligator Gar and tries his best to get all the action from his cell phone. Who knew that Texas Slough had fish that big in it.

programme.title: Slamm'n Salmon
programme.desc: Mathew heads west to South Dakota to meet up with AMS Staffers Ty Smith and Mark Morrison for some fall Salmon Bowfishing. South Dakota allows bowfishers the same opportunity as hook and line anglers to harvest a 5 possession daily bag limit. We tour the Whitlock Bay spawning station and talk with Bob Henton South Dakota Fisheries Biologist about the Chinook Salmon program and then head out for a chance to harvest a Salmon with our bow and arrow. Slamm'n Salmon, how cool is that.

programme.title: Boise Butterflys
programme.desc: The Snake River near Boise Idaho is home to many fish species but one in particular that we are after, the Butterfly Carp. We meet up Travis and Jenni Oviatt owners of Grinz N Finz guide service and Jana Waller host of Skull Bound Chronicles to see if we can check the Butterfly Carp off our bucket list. The early March cold temperatures, snow, and beautiful sunsets set the stage for these Flames of Fire the Butterfly Carp.

programme.title: Chasing the Push
programme.desc: Water erupts, backs and fins break the water surface, and large V-shaped wakes in the shallow water signal the annual Buffalo spawn. Derrick and Mathew get word that the spawn is on and don't hesitate to load the boat and head south to Chase the Push. Plus, we show you how to fillet and deep fry Buffalo for the table. Buffalo, eat them up Yum Yum.

programme.title: IT'S EPISODE 100 BABY! Interviews w/ AMS Crew, + Landon Conley & Giveaways (Ep. 100)
programme.desc:
Celebrate Episode 100 with us this week! We give away all kinds of gift cards, apparel, and gear! We also interview all the staff here at AMS, talk with Landon Conley, the 2024 Youth Bowfisher of the Year, AND play all the video submissions we received in the last week. Matt also shocks the world with yet ANOTHER bowfishing song that he heard while driving back from a night on the water. Get ready, the Roche A Cri River Rat has come out with a new bowfishing banger.
PLUS! ??
• Buff bet update
• AMS Boat improvements for 2025
• AMS Big 20 is RIGHT around the corner
• We hear from Waterboy's Bobby Bouche!?

programme.desc: Jana meets up with Jules McQueen in her home state of Wisconsin for an action packed few days on the water with Matt Schillinger and Derrick Schmidt of AMS Bowfishing.

programme.title: Underwater Lueys Part 1
programme.desc: Tim Wells chases Big Lueys in the woods, but now its time to chase Big Lueys under the water. Tim travels north and meets up with Mathew with AMS Bowfishing and the search is on for giant Buffalo or should we say Underwater Lueys.

programme.title: DOUBLE DOUBLE
programme.desc: Chris and Parker Gade and other family members head to Wyoming on a DIY antelope hunt!! They had a double double good time!!

programme.title: BIG POND BRUISERS
programme.desc: Lee Schneider and Zach Haas are heading back out onto Lake Michigan with Captain Fluffy in search of king salmon, coho, rainbows, or whatever else wants to bite!! Once we hit that magic hour, the action was non-stop!!!

programme.title: COLD TO HOT!

programme.title: LOW LIGHT SUCCESS PT 2
programme.desc: We continue with Parker Gade and his quest for a Wisconsin black bear with his dad Chris. No one said it would be easy!

programme.title: TURKEY TRIFECTA?

programme.title: ECUADOR PART 1: THE FORGOTTEN FRONTIER
programme.desc:
Wildlife Photographer and Filmmaker Ian Breland heads into a remote region of the Ecuadorian Amazon situated between the lower-altitude Amazon Basin and the snowy, towering peaks of the Andes. Ian and the professionals he's with are in search of rare, undescribed, and iconic reptile & amphibian species; many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
Despite being roughly the size of the state of Colorado, Ecuador harbors nearly 7% of the entire planet's biodiversity. This small but packed gem is currently the 17th most biodiverse country on the planet, though new discoveries and rediscoveries are rolling in every year- from plants, fish, and frogs to snakes and even mammals. The unique rainforests of Ecuador are equally as imperiled and silently exploited as they are exotic, and we must act now to both preserve and ethically appreciate what lies in the Forgotten Frontier.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART II: LOST IN PERFECTION
programme.desc:
The guys are in the middle of their Central American expedition, now entrenched within the absurdly rich Caribbean jungles surrounded by cloud forests with diverse green valleys. They hike all day and night through the rainforest, searching for primarily Eyelash Vipers, Coral Snakes, and Jumping Pit Vipers.
The second the team arrives, they realize that the snake density is through the roof, and conditions are ideal. The first night yields tons of snakes, even one that no one can identify. It seems every nook and cranny has something beautiful, and they guys are almost as happily exhausted as they are stoked.

programme.title: PERUVIAN AMAZON PART 1: MOTHER OF GOD
programme.desc:
Madre De Dios translates to "Mother of God" in Spanish- a name more appropriate to none other than this region of Peru. Situated in the SW Amazon Basin, it remains one of the most understudied, inaccessible, and wild expanses of life on Earth. Unlike the area we explored in Ecuador, this part of the Amazon sits at a lower elevation- meaning that the more herpetologically favorable climate sustains an unfathomably elevated level of biodiversity.
Ian, Mike, and Sean (joined by their extra cameraman Tyler Velasquez) venture into protected territory alongside the snaking (and snakey) Las Piedras river in search of all things herps. The country is home to over 400 species (and counting) of reptiles alone, and the area is generally accepted as a world class Field Herping mecca.
The guys don't have any specific targets besides EVERYTHING, and waste no time jumping into the bush alongside a myriad of resident naturalists and friends to see what can be uncovered.

programme.title: ECUADOR PART II: EXPLORING THE UNDISCOVERED
programme.desc:
Wildlife Photographer and Filmmaker Ian Breland is back in a remote region of the Ecuadorian Amazon- situated between the lower-altitude Amazon Basin and the snowy, towering peaks of the Andes. Ian and the professionals he's with are in search of rare, undescribed, and iconic reptile & amphibian species; many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
This time though, they're searching specifically for some incredible frog, toad, and salamander species. What they uncover is nothing short of mesmerizing.
Despite being roughly the size of the state of Colorado, Ecuador harbors nearly 7% of the entire planet's biodiversity. This small but packed gem is currently the 17th most biodiverse country on the planet, though new discoveries and rediscoveries are rolling in every year- from plants, fish, and frogs to snakes and even mammals. The unique rainforests of Ecuador are equally as imperiled and silently exploited as they are exotic, and we must act now to both preserve and ethically appreciate what lies in the Forgotten Frontier.

programme.title: PERUVIAN AMAZON PART II: DON'T LOSE THE FOREST THROUGH THE TREES
programme.desc:
Still in the Amazon, the team is rolling from one encounter to the next. Each find lights their eyes up like fireworks and keeps everyone pushing forward. With only a week left to experience pure bliss, it's all hands on deck for the better part of 24 hours a day. The final find though- no one imagined it would be so sweet.
While a quick dip into the largest rainforest on Earth may render one to conjure thoughts of their surroundings being immortal and indestructible- the truth is a sobering one. Roughly 1,100 square miles of Peru's forests are cut down every year—around 80% of them illegally. Fires burn where they shouldn't, uncontacted indigenous are pushed out of their homes, the sun gazes hotter, the rains hit harder. The main culprits of deforestation are small-scale agriculture, commercial mining and related road construction, and forest degradation is caused primarily by illegal logging.
The scars across Peru are visible from space, and if we can't sustainably progress while keeping love at the forefront of our decisions- the necessary prescription for biodiversity is annihilation.

programme.title: COLORADO: SUBTERRANEAN WONDERS
programme.desc:
Ian, Sean, and Mike's search for reptiles and amphibians lands them in an astoundingly rich haven which also happens to be the most threatened ecosystem on earth: Prairie Grasslands.
The nearly destroyed grasslands of Eastern Colorado may not seem like much to your average mall crawler, but if one just looks a little bit closer- you'll spot a wonderland unlike any other. Some of the planet's most striking snakes fill the caverns beneath your feet, with impressively venomous vipers blessing the ground you traverse.
The team wanders hours on end through grassy plains, flipping debris for a shot at revealing a glimpse into the world witnessed by few and appreciated by all find it.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART III: VALLEY OF DRAGONS
programme.desc:
Nearing the end of their Guatemala expedition, the team has one final (and impatiently awaited) location- the driest region in all of Central America, Motagua Valley. The valley resembles the boys' home, Arizona in uncanny ways- though it's uniqueness is unmatched.
The dry, shrubby hillsides are home to one of the planet's most critically endangered endemic species, the venomous Guatemalan Beaded Lizard. The group stays on a reserve (Reserva Natural Heloderma) in the last remaining fragments of the valley's ecosystem, and catch an incredible opportunity to see the lizards up close and help in the vital process of rewilding them in hopes that the population may stabilize.
They're also searching for a lifelong dream, the Central American Rattlesnake. The snake is almost more of a dragonesque creature than our lizard friends, and certainly a more imposing one.
The team expects hunting the rattlesnakes down to become a major struggle; yet they discover that despite massive habitat degradation and human impact, the valley is far more dense in reptilian concentration than anyone had anticipated.
There is still so much left to see- and save.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART 1: GUARDIANS OF THE CLOUD FOREST
programme.desc:
Guatemala sits in a Neotropical transitional area that connects South America to North America, through a narrowly winding stream of land with varying altitudes and landscapes that we've come to call Central America.
Ian, Mike, and Trent link up with Wildlife Photographer Andres Novales to travel across the country, targeting the different legendary and threatened species in each region. First, they tackle the prehistoric cloud forests, high altitude mountainous jungles that have fostered the evolution of many different venomous tree-dwelling pit vipers. The biggest targets here are the Yellow-blotched Palm Pit Viper and the Guatemalan Palm Pit Viper.
Stumbling through year's worth of decaying plant matter and vibrant palms towering over the group, they hike into unknown territory with big plans.

programme.title: CALIFORNIA: LAVA MONSTERS
programme.desc:
The gang continues on their road trip through the seemingly endless Sonoran Desert, seeking out deeply remote and arid regions. They head to a stunningly dry and convincingly sparse mountain range nested near the Mexico border in search of the esteemed white-phase Speckled Rattlesnake; soon moving on into Southern California.
The guys meet up with fellow herper, History Channel show host, and good friend Rob Alleva to track down a snake some in the group have only seen photos of- though none of them could have foreseen what they end up running into.
The final, and arguably most incredible pit stop of the trip is an ancient volcanic lava field. Here lies the main target of their 2-week blitz, the "lava-phase Speckled Rattlesnake". Harboring a nearly black color scheme known only from this specific area due to some fast paced evolution, these jaw dropping animals sometimes prove to be almost as hard to track down as they are pleasing to the eye.

programme.title: Aoudads & Diaper Bags
programme.desc: Getting eyes on a 30" aoudad ram is hard enough, Hunter Hill is chasing big Texas rams with a four week old baby girl and two young boys. Together with her husband Clay and good friend Cari Goss the crew takes it one step at a time to finally put some great rams in their crosshairs.

programme.title: Through Grit & Glory
programme.desc: One foot in front of the other is easier said than done on a 10 day dall sheep hunt in the remote mountains of British Columbia. Between a rock and a hard place Cari Goss is accustomed to putting in the effort to get hands on a legal ram. However this go round she is going to have to push through the grit to find the glory.

programme.title: Chasing Legends
programme.desc: Knowing a great buck is in the area is only half the battle, locating, stalking and sealing the deal is the other half. Everything either lines up or falls apart when chasing legends.

programme.title: Early Season TURKEY HUNT In Mississippi, Improving Mountain Habitat With Andy Melton | Chasing Red
programme.desc: Chasing Red is back for another turkey season and with opening day's around the country arriving, the excitement is super high around here. Kicking this episode off are team members Andy Melton and David Williams. The guys cover some great early season habitat tips, reflect on some of their hunts from last season, and look ahead to their upcoming trip in Florida where they'll be hunting Osceolas in the coming days. Following that we're heading down to Mississippi for Casen Holmes final youth season hunt with his dad Chad behind the camera. The gobblers do it right and the duo punch the first tag for the team this season. We're excited to bring this series to you again and as always, thank you for the support.

programme.title: Turkey Hunting TOUGH Conditions In Florida, A First Ever Gobbler In Georgia | Chasing Red
programme.desc: On this episode of Chasing Red, we're kicking things off by heading south to the state of Florida where team members Andy Melton and David Williams are turkey hunting for Osceola gobblers. The conditions have been extremely tough due to the prolonged heat but the duo gives their all and by the end, a long spurred tom is in range. Following this, we're jumping over to Georgia where longtime team member Dell Kirby is taking his grandsons hunting hoping to build another memory.

programme.title: Curved Spurred Gobbler In Florida, Turkey Hunting Curse Broken For Chad
programme.desc: We're kicking off a brand new season of Chasing Red down in Florida with Chad Holmes as he tries to break the turkey hunting curse that's been following him for the past year. After wrapping up Sunday service, Chad and the guys head south driving overnight 13 hours to make it in time for the morning hunt. This one is another example of how always being ready can make or break getting a shot and Chad does just that! Upon walking up on his gobbler, Chad spots a curved spur kicking off a great start to the '24 hunting season.

programme.title: Illinois Atypical State Record Turkey
programme.desc: Jake takes the Illinois atypical state turkey record with his bow on the first day of the season.

programme.title: Cow Patty Toms
programme.desc: Latisha Phipps hammers a tom in the cow pastures of Kentucky and Logan Roepke connects on a great bird in the youth turkey season in Illinois.

programme.title: Whitetail Sheds and Deads 2015 Part 1

programme.title: Please Stand Up

programme.title: Grandmas first ever Deer

programme.title: Bass Fishing with a Simple Walmart Bass Fishing Rod, Reel and Tackle Setup
programme.desc:
Need a quick and easy bass rod and reel setup? So did I! While out of town in Moultrie, Georgia for business, I forgot my bass rod and tackle at home, so I ran to the local Walmart and bought just what I needed for a great price. Walk with me as I pick out which bass fishing rod I prefer and why, than the lures I think would work best for bass while here in Moultrie, Georgia.
After purchasing my bass fishing rod and bass tackle from Walmart for a great price, I head on over to a local pond near the hotel I am staying at in Moultrie, Georgia. I than set up my new Lew's Speed Stick rod by attaching the Abu Garcia reel I bought to it. Then I string my Spiderwire braided fishing line through my new pole and attach some 20 pound mono to the end. After that I tie a size 3/0 Mustad offset hook to my line, put on split slide weights, and I am ready for the lure! I bought two different types of rubber worms. Purple Powerbaits and Watermelon Yum Dingers.
I am ready to catch some bass! On Day 1, I used the Watermelon worms and caught three gorgeous Georgia Bass! On Day 2 I tried to switch up to the purple and didn't get a single hit. Switched back to the Watermelon worms and caught a bass almost instantly!
