programme.title: Hunting the Rut in Mississippi - Part 1
programme.desc:
Hunting the Rut in Mississippi - Part 1
Husband and wife team, Reese & Amber Richards (owners of Bearded Outdoors) go on their first ever out of state hunt together to north Mississippi on the quest to harvest Amber's first buck ever! This is a two part series, so be sure you're following Bearded Outdoors so you don't miss Part 2!
"We were invited by the owners of Conviction Outdoors to come hunt their gorgeous rolling hills on almost 200 acres of private family land. They stayed in the cabin on the property as well which was hand built by the owner himself. Absolutely gorgeous! We were so blessed to have had this opportunity and we enjoyed the property, food, and fellowship very much! To have been invited back was icing on the cake!"

programme.title: 200 Disabled Veterans go Deep Sea Fishing in the Gulf!
programme.desc:
We were invited by Iron Men Outdoor Ministries to attend their Annual Deep Sea Fishing with Disabled Veterans trip. These two days consisted of a banquet to raise money and honor all of the disabled veterans that were invited on the fishing trip, as well as a day on the water, deep sea fishing on several boats!
There ended up being 200 disabled veterans fishing! There were 20 total boats that took these men and women fishing! Three of these boats were 90 foot fishing charter vessels, and the rest were smaller charter boats. The total number of fish caught exceeded 2000! The total number of fish kept was about 1600!
This entire trip was amazing to say the least! Being asked to film and collect content of what it is that Iron Men Ministries does, as well as to capture these disabled vets having a blast catching fish, was such an honor and so humbling! We are already counting down the days till the next one!
Here are all the ways to connect with Iron Men Outdoors: Website: https://www.ironmenoutdoorministries.com/ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IMOM2013 Festus Potee: https://www.facebook.com/festus.potee

programme.title: Sight Unseen
programme.desc:
In the premiere episode of Modern Homestead, Janna Breslin and Evan DeMarco take the plunge into a world they've never known before, as they embark on a journey that promises to challenge their limits, expand their horizons, and redefine their very notions of homesteading. What begins as a bold venture to buy 120 acres in the picturesque Tennessee landscape quickly transforms into an eye-opening experience that neither of them could have anticipated.
The episode kicks off with excitement and a sense of adventure as Janna and Evan, an unlikely pair consisting of a cover model and a scientist, reveal their audacious plan to create a thriving homestead capable of withstanding even the most unexpected challenges - including a potential zombie apocalypse. Armed with enthusiasm and a determination to master the art of self-sufficiency, they set out to build their dream oasis where they will source their own water, grow their own food, generate energy, and construct their own shelter.
However, as the saying goes, reality often has other plans. What Janna and Evan initially perceive as a straightforward path to their modern homesteading vision takes an unexpected turn. As they explore their new purchase, they encounter challenges that leave them both baffled and humbled. The land they imagined to be a canvas of endless possibilities presents them with a unique set of obstacles they hadn't foreseen.
Amidst the breathtaking beauty of the Tennessee landscape, the duo faces unexpected revelations. The landscape itself is both enchanting and unpredictable, with its own stories etched into every rock and tree. With each twist and turn, Janna and Evan's perceptions of their journey shift, and they find themselves relying on each other's strengths more than ever before.
As they dive deeper into their new reality, the couple discovers that their homesteading adventure is about more than just mastering survival skills; it's about embracing the unknown, learning from failures, and celebrating triumphs no matter how small. The episode captures the candid moments of frustration, laughter, and perseverance as they navigate through the challenges of homesteading.

programme.title: Chili Bathroom
programme.desc:
In the second episode of The Modern Homestead, Janna and Evan's journey gets off to a chaotic start when Janna wakes up with something very dangerous in her hair.
With Janna's hair emergency as a wake-up call, Evan swings into action and calls in the experts. They bring in a food security systems designer and a homesteading expert to help them navigate the complexities of their new life.
Simultaneously, the couple recognizes the pressing need to transform their cabin into a more safe, functional and comfortable space. This includes building a much-needed bathroom for those moments when Evan has a bit too much chili.
Episode two brings laughs, excitement and and the recognition that building the Modern Homestead might not be as easy as they thought,

programme.title: Breaking The Mold
programme.desc: In this episode of Modern Homestead, Janna and Evan start their cabin renovation but discover what they think is black mold. While awaiting a contractor, they visit a Florida homestead for an education on growing food.

programme.title: Water of Love
programme.desc: Janna and Evan address the water issues on The Modern Homestead. After attempting to fix the leaking ponds and address the well water problem, they take a trip to South Carolina to learn about some amazing technology that ensures they will always have water.

programme.title: Baa Baa
programme.desc: Janna and Evan catch an early flight from back from California to begin working on the greenhouse. Janna's lofty ideas for the green house, which include a full bar, put the project well over budget and way behind schedule. They turn to repurposing materials from an old hoop house Butch found in a field. Janna gets distracted by baby goats.

programme.title: Boats and Hoops
programme.desc:
After days filled with construction challenges, cabin renovations, and a daunting hoop house project, Janna and Evan decide it's time to unwind and recharge. Evan surprises Janna with a getaway to beautiful Lake Norris in Tennessee, hoping to enjoy a relaxing weekend away from the homestead.
With a speed boat and an innertube, relaxing is the last thing happens. Janna loses her top, her bottoms, her Whoop and her hair tie all in one run on the tube before learning to waterski.
Amid the chaos and wardrobe malfunctions, the couple finds joy in shared laughter and unexpected adventures, proving that even in the midst of homesteading challenges, the most treasured moments are often the ones unplanned and full of laughter.

programme.title: Func Shui
programme.desc: Evan has one last surprise up his sleeve for Janna before their return from a relaxing trip to the lake. It's llamas! They visit a llama farm, then return to find Jeff brought a construction crew for cabin renovations. The arrival of the construction crew adds a new layer of excitement to the homestead's transformation. Together with the construction crew, they begin to see their dream home taking shape in ways they never imagined.Evan invents a new design technique.

programme.title: Talk Dirty to Me
programme.desc:
In this episode of Modern Homestead, the challenges keep piling up for the Janna and Evan. The cabin, once a symbol of their dreams, is under siege from nature itself. As they open up the walls for much-needed renovations, they discover an alarming infestation of black mold. But that's not all; the back wall of the cabin has been entirely consumed by termites and carpenter ants, presenting a threat to the entire structure.
Jeff takes on the daunting task of tackling these issues, while Janna and Evan shift their focus to building the gardens, preparing for the upcoming planting season. Evan gives a crash course in the science and art of soil.
The episode also features a cozy fireside chat, where Butch and Jeff pick up their guitars for a special "Modern Homestead Unplugged" acoustic set.
In "Talk Dirty to Me," the homesteaders are reminded that a homestead is more than just a house; it's a living, breathing project that requires their unwavering dedication and resourcefulness.

programme.title: Creeping Thyme
programme.desc: Janna and Evan continue to face challenges with the inside of the cabin but are able to get the outside corked using a new building material. Friends and family show up to help with the outside gardens, getting them closer to food security.

programme.title: Guns, Bows and BigFoot
programme.desc: With termite damage causing significant setbacks in their cabin renovation, Janna and Evan decide to channel their frustrations into a friendly yet competitive shooting and archery contest. This episode not only showcases their skills but also addresses the importance of security on the homestead from both a technical and practical standpoint. Amidst the competition, with a special prize for the winner, they also encounter a surprise introduction to a potentially influential neighbor on their property, adding an intriguing twist to their journey.

programme.title: Domestead
programme.desc: In the season 1 finale, Janna and Evan provide an intimate and heartfelt recap of their first year in off-grid living, a journey filled with both triumphs and trials. This episode stands as a milestone, marking the completion of their 30-foot dome, a significant achievement that allows them to finally sleep on their homestead.

programme.title: Detroit River Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis M. Creech and Paul Laurain as they capitalize on Lake Erie's largest Walleye migration into the Detroit River. The Spring Walleye Run in Detroit is absolutely epic and you won't want to miss this non-stop action of some total hog walleyes in this episode of Michigan Fishing Nation TV!

programme.title: Spring Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Melanie, Diana, Andrew and Paul for some Spring Walleye jigging action on the St. Clair River in Port Huron, Michigan! Jigging is when you catch walleye in the rivers using an up and down motion while simultaneously using your trolling motor to stay vertical while navigating through the current. It's one of the most challenging ways to fish. You won't wanna miss these awesome fish!

programme.title: Lake Huron Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Wife Melanie, their boys Aiden and Colton, along with Uncle Adam, as they travel to Fort Gratiot, Michigan, to get after some Great Lakes Walleyes on Lake Huron. This area and episode really showcases the beauty of Michigan's Great Lakes, you won't wanna miss this! Thanks for tuning in to Michigan Fishing Nation TV.

programme.title: St. Clair River Sturgeon Fishing
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Mel and Paul as they target Michigan's oldest Prehistoric Fish in Algonac, Michigan, the mighty Sturgeon! Imagine hooking into a freshwater shark and nearly snapping your rod in half during the fight! Dive below the depths of the St. Clair River at night with Curtis and the gang! You will not want to miss this action packed episode of Michigan Fishing Nation TV.

programme.title: Smallmouth Bass Fishing
programme.desc: Join Curtis as he tries Kayak Fishing for the first time near Michigan's Hidden Gem, "Turnip Rock" in search of some Smallmouth gold! Once they start casting, you will not believe the non-stop Lake Huron Smallmouth Bass action! This is a trip for the record books that you will not want to miss.

programme.title: River Trolling & Whipping for Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, wife Melanie, Brother-in-law Adam and Father-in-law Fred for an amazing episode on Michigan's St. Clair River from Marysville as they troll down the river for Walleye during the day and transition to the local tactic of "whipping" at night! By the end of this episode, you'll have everything you need to start cracking that whip and have a boat-load of walleyes!

programme.title: Motor City Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Melanie and Paul as they venture across the Detroit River between Michigan and Canada (Ontario) in search of some icy cold Walleyes for the fryer! This is the video you'll want to watch to learn how you can get on the river and jig up some tasty walleyes!

programme.title: How to Jig for Michigan Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Adam and Paul as they scout for Walleye near the Blue Water Bridge in Port Huron Michigan and Sarnia in Ontario, Canada. This is a great how-to video on jigging for river walleyes.

programme.title: Winter Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Curtis and Paul venture out between Michigan and Canadian waters of Ontario in search of some tasty Winter Walleye on the St. Clair River.

programme.title: Walleye Jigging Mayhem 2025
programme.desc: Curtis, Adam and Andrew venture out into the icy St. Clair River to pull in some hog walleyes!

programme.title: Hawaii Wild Boar And Spearfishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the island of Maui to hunt for wild pigs and do some spearfishing. You won't believe the double shot Kyle makes on pigs!

programme.title: Alaska Sockeye Salmon
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to Alaska to fish for sockeye salmon with his cousin William, and buddy Mike. They catch limits every day and enjoy the most beautiful scenery in the world!

programme.title: High Mountain Chukar
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the mountains in Eastern Washington to target chukar. This frustrating upland bird makes for a great adventure!

programme.title: Channel Islands Fishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads out to the Channel Islands National Park 30 miles offshore to fish for halibut and whitefish. The amount of fish they see while spearfishing is incredible!

programme.title: Hawaii Axis Deer
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the island of Maui to hunt Axis Deer! Jeff gets a giant buck and Kyle embarks on an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: Snake River Cutthroat
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to the Snake River in Idaho to fish for rainbow trout and work with the DNR to help save the cutthroat trout. The management of this fishery is a touchy subject, but the team follows the science to get real answers!

programme.title: The Great Washington Bird Hunt
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to Washington State to hunt for ducks and quail. Lots of birds and lots of laughs in this high-action episode!

programme.title: Inland Lake Ice Fishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team targets northern pike through the ice with their buddy Scott Slater. The big one they catch is a beauty!

programme.title: Noodling Giant Catfish
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads down to Texas to try their hand at noodling. Did they catch a new Texas state record blue cat?

programme.title: Manistee River King Salmon
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors heads to the Manistee River in Northern Michigan to target King Salmon! Jeff catches an absolute monster!

programme.title: Prehistoric Paddlefish
programme.desc: Kyle Green travels to Oklahoma to fish for a prehistoric dinosaur called the paddlefish. He never expected the action to be this good!

programme.title: Giant Lake Sturgeon
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team head out on the St Clair river to target giant lake sturgeon with their buddy Mitch. The monster Kyle caught was way over the slot limit!

programme.title: The Florida Kingfish
programme.desc: Kyle Green travels to Florida with his Sea-Doo FishPro Trophy to target kingfish, snook and giant Tarpon! He meets up with Frank Viola and Bri Andrassy who take Kyle out of his freshwater comfort zone. They go 7 miles out to sea, fish under docks, and everything in between. Don't miss the biggest fish we have ever featured on our show!

programme.title: THE MAINE MOOSE
programme.desc: The chances of getting drawn for moose tag in the state of Maine is slim to none. However, since the winter tick problem has been getting so bad in moose populations the department of fish and game has had to open up more opportunity for hunters to kill these ticks with moose hunting. How does that work?

programme.title: ALAKSA SOCKEYE SALMON
programme.desc: The last frontier is not a place for the faint of heart. It's full of natural resources that can harvested if you're willing to go on an adventure for it! Kyle and his cousin, William, go out for the sought after, sockeye salmon. Kyle is learning a new method of fishing that could be frowned upon if practiced in other places of North America. This method is called flossing.

programme.title: THE SNAKEHEAD FISH
programme.desc: A fish that heals you? Many cultures believe that the snakehead fish has healing capabilities that can even cure cancer. That is part of the reason why this invasive species ended up in the North American waterways. Kyle and Jeff visit Maryland to understand how the locals have turned this invasive species into a positive!

programme.title: THE MYSTERIOUS 10,000 ISLANDS
programme.desc: What do Native Americans, Pirates and Drug Smugglers all have in common? The 10,000 Islands of South West Florida. Kyle heads out on an adventure to see if he can catch, cook, camp and learn a few things about these mysterious chain of islands that many before him had somehow survived on.

programme.title: REMOTE LAKE ICE FISHING
programme.desc: What snowmobiles and Trout have in common? They both have thriving populations in Idaho. Kyle meets up with Idaho biologist, Bret High. Bret takes Kyle deep into the mountains of Idaho to see how well the trout are doing in the remote lakes that were previously stocked by Idaho fish and game.

programme.title: THE TEXAS GATOR HUNT
programme.desc:
Snakes, rotten chicken, gators, and Texas Heat. Kyle, Jeff and Ryan visit their buddy in Texas to harvest these prehistoric lizards.
Only one problem, Kyle and Jeff made a bet...

programme.title: BISON BISON BISON
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors heads to Oklahoma to learn a history lesson about the North American Bison.

programme.title: UPPER PENNISULA TROUT ADVENTURES
programme.desc: Kyle, Jeff and their friend, Scott, spend some time in their home state. They visit places that were surrounds with Native American legends, giant cliffs and of course some trout fishing.

programme.title: INVASIVE CARP DISASTER
programme.desc: Kyle heads to South Dakota to see for himself how bad the invasive asian carp problem is. With the help of his friend Erin "Chummy" Riibe, they head out onto the water to blowfish for these invasive fish.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #1 - Robbie Kroger "In the Blood"
programme.desc: What is Blood Origins? Robbie Kroger tells us about his philosophy on what Blood Origins means and relates it to his story. A South African native, he has come to the United States and is looking to his past to learn more about what hunting meant to him and his family for generations.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #2 - Keith Polk & Lake Pickle "Threaded"
programme.desc: Everyone has a story… For Lake & Keith, it is one of mentorship, lifelong friendship, and a passion for sharing their love of hunting with younger generations. Through a program bringing the hunting experience to younger generations, they came to know more about their love of the outdoors and being a role model. The tradition then lived on through their experiences like many other traditions in the hunting community.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #3 - Ryan "Koup" Kuperus "Giants"
programme.desc: Ryan "Koup" Kuperus is a retired USMC Gunnery Sergeant. After a devastating Humvee rollover accident, his femur and back were both broken. The nature of his accident and experiences overseas left him searching for answers on how to adjust to life at home. The outdoors and hunting provided him with an escape. Now, he works on engaging other veterans and people going through experiences like his to hunting and the outdoors. Using the experiences of nature and hunting traditions, he works to give others the healing he found in the peacefulness of the wilderness.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #4 - Craig Corsi "Giants"
programme.desc: Craig Corsi lives the hunting life dedicated to the outdoors. A retired USMC 1st Sergeant, the path Corsi has chosen for himself is based on the tenants of family, hunting, and dedication to the outdoors. Through his business and lifestyle, he can invest in others and bring more experiences to those around him looking to understand the hunting tradition.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #5 - Cuz Strickland "Heart"
programme.desc: As one of the originators, Cuz Strickland has the insight to tell a story more rooted in hunting and tradition than most. He was focused from experiences at a young age on how hunting and humanity came together. He aims to always make that experience available to young people. He wants the hunters of tomorrow to see the outdoors and love of the forests from a lense of understanding and respect.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #8 - Leonard Bentz "Fathers"
programme.desc: Your story is likely unique to you, just as my own story is probably unlike yours.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #12 - Derek Harris "Memories"
programme.desc: From an early age Derek was raised to be a different breed of hunter. It wasn't all about the kill. His dad instilled in him that being outdoors is an experience. Being outdoors is about making memories and relationships with others. He would take these same values and instill them into his little brother. As he matured Derek took this one step further, by becoming a professional outfitter in New Mexico, and took it as a profession to take others hunting and into the outdoors to make their own memories

programme.desc: The Barbed Team teaches you the ins and outs of sticking fish

programme.title: Common Carp
programme.desc: Learn all about the Common carp, and why its so important to help control;l the numbers in the lakes rivers and streams

programme.title: Buffalo Fish
programme.desc: learn all about Buffalo Fish, also known as Buffalo carp. How to find them, where to find them, and when to find them in specific areas

programme.title: Showing Silvers
programme.desc: Learn techniques on bowfishing for Silver Carp

programme.title: Bowfishing Cownose Rays
programme.desc: The team explains some tactics, tips and strategies on bowfishing for Cownose rays

programme.title: Michigan Pope and Young Bow Hunt
programme.desc: Derek Proulx takes us on his 2022 bow season and capitalizes on a beautiful Michigan 10 point with his bow.

programme.title: First Time Turkey Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Proulx and Jeremiah Saier take their kids, Gemma and Easton, out turkey hunting in search for their first Michigan longbeards.

programme.title: Soque Trout
programme.desc: The north Georgia mountains have some of the best trout fishing in the US. Capt. Cefus McRae fishes the fabled Soque River with Unicoi Outfitters for trophy rainbow trout.

programme.title: AirBoat Trout
programme.desc: Capt. Cefus McRae and Capt. John Wells explore the skinny water backcountry of Florida 's Big Bend targeting speckled trout and redfish on a windy day. They fish waters only accessible by an air boat.

programme.title: Fishing Adventures Florida
programme.desc: Capt. Sergio, Capt. George is joined with Capt. Brian Goldman in search of shallow water redfish in upper Tampa Bay. Extreme low tides the captains wor hard but it paid off

programme.title: Fishing Adventures Florida
programme.desc: The Captains with the help of Capt. Michael Dawson search for snook around the out islands. Fighting high winds and falling tide made it difficult fishing but at the end of the day some new techniques made it happen

programme.title: Lake Poygan Walleyes
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors we hit Lake Poygan for a two day Walleye bite. We brought Terry from BiteMeBox and I even had two of my kids (Isaac, Sawyer, and his Girlfriend Jen) out on the lake. Unbelievable Walleye bite for beginnings of new ICE! Check out the motherload of fish we caught!

programme.title: Next Stop Ep209: Queensland, Australia
programme.desc: Next Stop visits Queensland, Australia and explores The Great Barrier Reef, Cairns Tropical Zoo, the Daintree Discovery Centre and Tjapukai Aboriginal Cultural Park.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep112: Deep White - Why Sharks Attack
programme.desc: Deep White explores ways to research sharks to determine why sharks attack and to study innovative ways to train sharks in order to prevent future attacks. Sharks are surprisingly intelligent and able to perform complex tasks. Sharks can distinguish different signals and cues in feeding routines and they develop strong bonds with their trainers.

programme.title: Xplash Ep110
programme.desc: Xplash brings you amazing action in, on, and near water. In this episode, we travel to the Bahamas and witness a world freediving record, fish for crocodiles with coconuts on a rope, and start the show off by checking out a new evolution in human flight.

programme.title: The Great Barrier Reef: World's most amazing coral reef
programme.desc: This expedition to the Great Barrier Reef is designed to study the health and resilience of one of the world’s most amazing coral reefs. The expedition’s goal is to collect data about the world's most remote reefs and build a picture of how reefs are faring in today's changing climate.

programme.title: Sports Adventure Ep503: The Wellerbrucke Rapids… A Kayaker’s Dream
programme.desc: The Wellerbrucke rapid is a world class kayaker’s dream. Not only offering up great freestyle adventures, it also hosts the Adidas Sick-line Extreme Kayak Championships. This competition is seen through the eyes of 3-time champion Sam Sutton.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep110: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: Mothballed, de-commissioned naval vessels are toxic time-bombs, filled with PCB’s, asbestos, lead paint, oil and grease. Hundreds rust in dockyards around the world. What can be done with them? A team of Canadians has developed an innovative solution…they clean the ships...then sink them!

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures: Kings of Texas
programme.desc: Captain Rick Murphy is on the troll for kingfish in Port Mansfield, Texas. Guiding him to the fish is Captain Chad Kinney from Texas Insider Fishing Report.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep110: Bull Sharks in Cancun, Mexico + Sharks Electrosensory Systems
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV dives with Bull Sharks in Cancun, Mexico and analyzes shark's electrosensory systems.

programme.title: Liquid Edge Ep102
programme.desc: Liquid Edge leaps into canyon pools with the Deap Canyoning Team, captures a first waterfall descent with kayak superstar Steve Fisher, showcases surf cinematographer Larry Haynes, searches the world for secret surf spots via the film Planet Blow, and features an epic swell via Oakley’s Wave of the Winter.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa Ep206: Victoria Falls…The Smoke That Thunders
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.title: The Surfing Lifestyle Ep104: In Search of Perfect Waves
programme.desc: A key component of The Surfing Lifestyle is to venture to lesser travelled parts of the world in search of perfect waves, and Dru Adler, Adam Bennetts and their surfboard shaper Daniel MacDonald, did exactly that in southern Sumatra where they found uncrowded perfection and adventure around every turn.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep106: Shark Divers Part 1
programme.desc: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums. Shark Divers focuses on this diverse and eclectic dive group…each with different motives in their fascinating fields.

programme.title: Facing Waves Ep504: Paddling the Swedish-Norwegian Borderlands
programme.desc: Host Heather Herbeck explores the Swedish-Norwegian Borderlands region near Värmland, Sweden on her stand-up paddleboard and competes in a 55K kayak race.

programme.title: Hot Water Ep112: Aquabike World Championship Series
programme.desc: The UIM ABP Aquabike World Championship is in Olbia, Sardinia, for the Grand Prix of Italy, featuring the Aquabike Jetski Division.

programme.title: Travel Quest Ep105: Yap
programme.desc: This remote Pacific island is a diver’s paradise and we take advantage of this by diving with giant Manta Rays the size of a small plane. The craziest dive though is when Bill feeds dozens of sharks with no protective gear. We also film where no one has filmed before…The Forbidden Island.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep111: Sand Tiger Sharks as Protectors
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV demonstrates how Sand Tiger Sharks act as protectors and takes a Deeper Dive by explaining male vs female shark differences, shark reproduction, Gray Reef Sharks and shark buoyancy.

programme.title: World of Watersports Ep315: Cliff Diving, Wing Foiling and Sailing
programme.desc: World of Watersports explores the dangerous sport of Cliff Diving and profiles Gary Hunt - one of the very best cliff divers on the planet. In addition, WOW features wing foiling in Switzerland and Bacardi Cup Sailing in Bermuda.

programme.title: Blue World Ep606: The Amazing Comeback of Gray Seals + Shark Performances in the Philippines
programme.desc: Gray seals look like cute swimming puppy dogs, and their story of recovery from the brink of extinction is one of history's best examples of conservation. Then we travel to the town of Oslob in the Philippines, where the locals have switched from hunting Whale Sharks to teaching them to perform for tourists.

programme.title: Xplash Ep111
programme.desc: The Xplash action is intense as we kayak Africa's Zambezi River, go behind-the-scenes of Australia's V8 Powerboat Racing, and head north to the icy waters of Canada and Alaska for coldwater surfing.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter: The Fishing Was on FIRE!
programme.desc: Mike got to live out a childhood dream of being a fireman for a day! After taking firefighter, and military veteran, Jeff Latkowski fishing in the kayaks, Jeff showed Mike what it takes to be a firefighter in the agility course that truly tests what you're made of.

programme.title: Next Stop Ep211: Kauai, Hawaii
programme.desc: Next Stop tours Jurassic Park Waterfall (aka Manawaiopuna Falls) via helicopter, kayaks with Outfitters Kauai, and goes tubing with Kauai Backcountry Adventures.

programme.title: Mapping The Blue: World's largest Marine Park
programme.desc: The Cook Islands recently announced the designation of the largest Marine Park on Earth. In stunning 4K imagery, this documentary tells the story of how Kevin Iro, founder of the park, along with his team, use a high tech GIS system to designate multi-use areas inside the pristine park.

programme.title: Sports Adventure Ep510: Kayaking the Remote Sary-Jaz River in China's Tien Shan Mountains
programme.desc: The Sickline Kayaking Team travels to the remote Sary-Jaz River, located in the Tien Shan Mountains, which straddle the borders of China, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan. Expedition leader Tomass Marnics, along with several World Champion kayakers kayak the breathtaking Eyes of God Gorge.

programme.title: Travel Quest Ep110: Botswana
programme.desc: Botswana is a wildlife lover’s dream and it’s also the home of Victoria Falls…the largest waterfalls in the world. Travel Quest's host, Bill Ball, joined a whitewater raft team in order to film the most wild and treacherous rapids in the world. He would not leave unscathed.

programme.title: Water Matters Ep103: Plastics & Pollution
programme.desc: Water Matters documents water-related environmental issues from around the globe as a number of the world’s best documentary filmmakers and environmental organizations share their stories regarding the planet’s water crisis as well as potential solutions for a healthier world.

programme.title: HealthDay - Mental Health and Depression
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll talk with a group of nurses about their experiences dealing with increased workplace violence and harassment during the COVID-19 pandemic. We’ll also go over the effects of COVID-19 and irregular sleep patterns on depression in children and adults.

programme.title: HealthDay - Improving Heart Health
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll talk with the chair of last year’s American Heart Association Scientific Sessions on new diet guidelines and programs to combat health inequity. We’ll also share tips on improving your heart health and identifying potential symptoms of heart damage and disease.

programme.title: HealthDay - Health Tips for Seniors
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll talk with several experts on the often stigmatized topic of sexual intimacy among older adults. We’ll also share information on how seniors can slow the spread of Parkinson’s disease, deal with symptoms of menopause, and reduce their risk of Alzheimer’s.

programme.title: HealthDay - Health and the Environment
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll cover common public health issues caused by smog, pollen, and other environmental hazards. We’ll also discuss how to avoid Lyme disease, West Nile virus, and sinusitis.

programme.title: HealthDay - Fighting Health Inequity
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll speak with experts on how the lack of accessibility to basic healthcare has affected people around the country, as well as what steps can be taken to ensure greater health equity.

programme.title: HealthDay - Drug Treatment and Therapy
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll talk with a former cancer patient who was treated with psilocybin about his experiences, as well as a psychiatry professor who has spent decades researching the effects of medical hallucinogens.

programme.title: HealthDay - Drug Abuse and Overdoses
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll be discussing the dangers of drug abuse and addiction, speaking with doctors and survivors of opioid abuse on the factors behind the recent spike in addiction across the country.

programme.title: OmStars- Yoga Is Series - Yoga Is - Day 18 Awakening Anjaneyasana
programme.desc: In today’s lesson we will use the crescent lunge to awaken the energy at the core of your being.

programme.title: OmStars- Yoga Is Series - Yoga Is - Day 19 Wisdom Side Plank
programme.desc: For day 19 we will use side plank as the vehicle of awareness that might help us glimpse the truth of any given moment.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy - Good Morning Joy - Unlocking Happiness
programme.desc: Celebrity hypnotist Tim Shurr helps you unlock happiness and shed anxiety. Shari tests her hypnotizability, and the story of a woman who took back her mental health by empowering women worldwide. Plus, live from Heartfulness headquarters in India.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy - Good Morning Joy - Triumph Over Trauma
programme.desc: 1963 Playboy Icon and Cosby Survivor, Victoria Valentino, shares her journey of overcoming unimaginable circumstances leading her to activism and purpose. Plus, one man's heroic efforts to save a tiny, unconscious life, and fun street interviews from NYC.

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show - Thriving in Later Years
programme.desc: Lisa Garr talks with retired therapist Connie Zweig, who says it’s possible to thrive as we age. She is an expert in the shadow self" & teaches aging as a spiritual practice. Her latest book is “The Inner Work of Age: Shifting from Role to Soul.”"

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show - Thriving in Later Years (Arielle Ford)
programme.desc: Lisa Garr talks with retired therapist Connie Zweig, who says it’s possible to thrive as we age. She is an expert in the shadow self" & teaches aging as a spiritual practice. Her latest book is “The Inner Work of Age: Shifting from Role to Soul.”

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show - Healing Trauma
programme.desc: Lisa Garr talks with psychiatrist Dr. Paul Conti on the invisible epidemic which impacts us all on some level. He believes it’s trauma. A graduate of Stanford University & former chief resident at Harvard, he is a leading trauma treatment expert.

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show: Dr Jill Bolte Taylor - Whole Brain Living and Choice
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show: Robert Thurman - Wisdom is Bliss
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

programme.title: The Wright Turn - The Wright Turn: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: La Dolce Vita (Sweet Life) - Ten years after the divorce from Maxwell Turner, with children grown, Celeste Wright Turner makes a choice to start living her life. No SEX with the EX! Simon and Mimi try to get Celeste’s head on straight when it comes to Maxwell’s charm. After facing an emotional challenge, Celeste decides to take a trip abroad.

programme.title: Sex Talk - Sex Talk - Beware of Casual Sex on Vacation

programme.desc: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inductees, Rod Argent and Colin Blunstone of The Zombies, are today's guests on Life Stories with Marc Hoberman. programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E1
programme.desc: HOPE IS HERE features inspiring and uplifting, relevant and refreshing, personal stories told by cancer survivors, their families, and the loved ones of those who lost the fight against this “emperor of all maladies” and sparked a movement that gives added meaning to their lives. Their moving stories show how the light of hope is salvaged from depths of despair.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E2
programme.desc: Lung cancer diagnoses for young, non-smoking individuals are a growing trend. But that didn't intimidate the athletic and courageous lung cancer patient, 21-year-old Jill Costello. Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E3
programme.desc: Hank Baskett was given the grim diagnosis of stage 4 lung cancer almost ten years ago. At the time his thoughts were not of himself but of how he was going to tell his family. In episode 3 of Hope is Here we meet Hank and his family and learn how he was able to push forward towards health with a hopeful attitude and mission that his cancer journey would be, in his words, a joyful one.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E4
programme.desc: Gina Hollenbeck is positive about life. Every day she lives with an optimistic desire to overcome and thrive despite a stage 4 lung cancer diagnosis. As a young mother of two boys, she forges ahead towards a vibrant and meaningful journey with a mission to help find a cure for not only herself but for others who suffer from this deadly disease.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E5
programme.desc: Emily Bennett Taylor and her husband Miles were newlyweds with a bright future planned. Just as they were house hunting and talking about raising a family Emily received the news that she had stage 4 lung cancer. She and her husband recall their cancer journey and recount their determination to live life to its fullest while fighting for the chance to have children despite a grave cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E6
programme.desc: Life can be full of hope and dreams. Lisa Briggs was enjoying a successful business, and a close-knit family while celebrating the arrival of her second child. Yet within months of giving birth Lisa was told the devastating news; she had stage 4 lung cancer. For an athletic, young woman who never smoked, the diagnosis seemed unreal. After the shock wore off, Lisa went into full action ahead as her will to live proved stronger than her devastating cancer.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Why Do We Have Insatiable Hunger?
programme.desc: Hopefully by now you understand that you gain weight because you have eaten more energy than you have burned in your day and stored that energy in your fat cells. But, have you ever wondered WHY you are overeating — i.e. eating more than you are burning? Why do we have such insatiable appetites when our bodies are usually pretty good at staying in balance? And no… it’s not because you have no willpower. This episode digs into where the physiological and psychological hunger is coming from — and how to cope with it.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Way Beyond Willpower: Managing Relationships and Environments to Beat Temptation
programme.desc: Willpower is like a muscle: If you use it long enough without a break, it fatigues. It’s the moment at the Mexican restaurant when they go to drop the chips and you say, 'No thanks.' If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. We also cover some serious boundary setting, so get ready.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Cheat Codes
programme.desc: There are certainly things that can add a plus to our A, but these aren’t replacements for eating better and moving more. Nothing in this lesson will come close to impacting your results like diet and exercise. Nonetheless, Jillian offers her thoughts on cold exposure, heat exposure, and supplements.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Your Complete Weight-Loss Plan
programme.desc: A big goal (if you have one) can feel a bit intimidating or overwhelming. This episode is here to help remove any of those anxious feelings with something called a goal pyramid. This simple technique will help you know exactly what to do and when to make that vision a reality!

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 3: The 3 Minds NEW
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

programme.desc: Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - This Is Why You 'Can’t Lose Weight'
programme.desc: The media tells you, 'Don’t worry! You’re big and you’re beautiful.' That you are healthy at any size. Nice to hear, but it simply isn’t true. Pharma companies and many in the medical community are now going to tell you it’s genetic — a disease of the brain that results in an insatiable hunger. They do this because surgeries and weight loss drugs are profitable. In this lesson, we will address these issues one by one.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Calories: Everything You Need to Know
programme.desc: Let’s use a quick analogy: If your body is a car, then reverse is actively gaining weight, neutral is not gaining or losing, and drive is weight loss… Ultimately you have been eating more than you are burning, which is what put the weight on in the first place. By controlling the calories in, we generally shift the car from reverse to neutral. No longer gaining, but not really losing a ton. By adding exercise into the mix we throw the car into drive without compromising your metabolism or muscle mass.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Body Fat: Why and How It Accumulates in Excess and What We Can Do About It
programme.desc: This lesson is the 101 on all things 'body fat' — what it actually is, what it does in and for the body, and what is considered a healthy body fat percentage. And, most importantly – for your purposes – how does it build up or, rather, get stored in the body and, conversely, how does it get released or “burned” off? Don’t worry, we aren’t going down a biochemistry rabbit hole here. These are just the must-know essentials.

programme.desc: This lesson discusses the connection between hormones and metabolism. The goal here is to get your hormones in balance, which will regulate your appetite, optimize your BMR, and help you maintain lean body mass. The good news is that to do this we don’t need a deep dive on each and every hormone because what’s good for one hormone is typically good for all of them. Meaning, the recommendations in this lesson help bring your entire body into balance — so you don’t have to deal with each hormone on a case-by-case basis.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Relevance of Macros & Micros
programme.desc: At long last you have arrived at the diet section of this course. And while technically this episode is about food quality, this is where Jillian answers all your questions about popular fad diets. Keto, Carnivore, Paleo, Pegan, Vegan, Vegetarian, Low Fat, Intermittent Fasting, Low Glycemic. Which is best?! Find out what matters most for weight loss.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Role of Exercise in Weight Loss
programme.desc: Finally, the exercise episode! Exercise is the most powerful lever you can pull when it comes to longevity, health, and weight loss. It’s also the number one form of preventative medicine and helps prevent yo-yo dieting. Here Jillian provides clear guidelines for how much and what types of exercises you should be building into your weekly routine.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Why Do We Have Insatiable Hunger?
programme.desc: Hopefully by now you understand that you gain weight because you have eaten more energy than you have burned in your day and stored that energy in your fat cells. But, have you ever wondered WHY you are overeating — i.e. eating more than you are burning? Why do we have such insatiable appetites when our bodies are usually pretty good at staying in balance? And no… it’s not because you have no willpower. This episode digs into where the physiological and psychological hunger is coming from — and how to cope with it.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Way Beyond Willpower: Managing Relationships and Environments to Beat Temptation
programme.desc: Willpower is like a muscle: If you use it long enough without a break, it fatigues. It’s the moment at the Mexican restaurant when they go to drop the chips and you say, 'No thanks.' If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. We also cover some serious boundary setting, so get ready.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Cheat Codes
programme.desc: There are certainly things that can add a plus to our A, but these aren’t replacements for eating better and moving more. Nothing in this lesson will come close to impacting your results like diet and exercise. Nonetheless, Jillian offers her thoughts on cold exposure, heat exposure, and supplements.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Your Complete Weight-Loss Plan
programme.desc: A big goal (if you have one) can feel a bit intimidating or overwhelming. This episode is here to help remove any of those anxious feelings with something called a goal pyramid. This simple technique will help you know exactly what to do and when to make that vision a reality!

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Today, we're going to be talking about opening to joy. programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Light Watkins

programme.desc: Today, you will learn how to tap into your unwavering inner knowing, which is also and often called your intuition. Kimberly Synder shares why being connected to your inner source of beauty is so important.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 1
programme.desc: Human biology is a symphony played between the body and the greater nature around us. The great conductor of that symphony, in many ways, is the gut and microbiome. This course will take a multifaceted look at this organ system � which is our primary interface with the chemistry of the world � so you can get an understanding of how to co-create health and well-being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 2
programme.desc: You have an intimate relationship with everything you put in your mouth. The tongue is a magical instrument for you to start to remember the power of flavor and nutrients, to slow it down and experience food again.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 3
programme.desc: The esophagus is simply a tube that runs from mouth to stomach, moving food from one to the other. And yet, as we dig into its structure, we find an extraordinarily complicated and intricate organ that has a deep relationship to the beauty of the body. The reality of this simple tube ends up displaying the sheer miracle of a day in the life of a human being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 4
programme.desc: In terms of its surface area and musculature, the stomach is designed to listen to your food. What is your stomach listening to? It�s listening to how your food was grown, lived, and died. It�s picking up on the microRNA that was in your food right at the moment you consumed it.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 7: Prana
programme.desc: Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Easing into Back Bending
programme.desc: Establish long term success for your practice by learning about one of the most crucial body parts in yoga—your spine. programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: From Cobra to Camel
programme.desc: This vinyasa class applies what you learned in Day 1 so you can play with classic backbends and steady transitions. programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Foundations of Forward Bending

programme.desc: This class primarily focuses on increasing the flexibility and suppleness of your cervical spine (the top 7 vertebrae, otherwise known as your neck). We tend to neglect the neck when we practice/train. It has the tendency to be stiff and weak. So, before we practice some strength building mobility work in the next class, let's stretch it out and create some more space in the areas that tend to hold tension. Get your strap out and get ready for some yummy, feel-good stretches that lengthen the tissues of your neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 2
programme.desc: Now that we've stretched out our necks and created some space in this area, let's add some mobility work to the mix. This class is all about strengthening the neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Boulder Shoulders
programme.desc: The shoulders are the seat of the neck. They influence the way it moves and positions itself in space. When we strengthen and stabilize the shoulders we free up room for better mechanics in the neck. This class will take you on a journey in all the directions the shoulder can mobilize. Let's go.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Flexion Section (Abdominals)
programme.desc: A strong stable core is truly the foundation for proper movement mechanics. Most of us are stuck in spinal extension. Our ribs flare out and our lower back is overly compressed. We need to learn how to access our abdominal muscles through articulating our spine into flexion. Here's a class that will toughen up your abdominal muscles, and teach you how to flex and segment your spine efficiently.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.desc: Your hormones work like a symphony. When every instrument is in tune, they play harmoniously. However, if one instrument is out of tune, or one hormone is out of balance, the entire piece is thrown off. Together, we'll decode your symptoms and work with your body to create hormonal balance. This means clear skin, easier periods, less hot flashes, better sex, and more restful sleep. Yes, it can be that good when your hormones are in check.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 2: Adrenal Glands
programme.desc: This sentence sums it up: The adrenal glands are the foundation of hormone balancing. If your adrenals aren't functioning at full capacity, you'll feel it. In today's lesson, we take a deep dive into the hormones that our adrenal glands produce. We'll start to get an idea of why taking care of and keeping these glands happy is so important.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 5: Estrogen
programme.desc: You can thank estrogen for keeping your lips full and plump and your body curvy. Today, we take a deep dive into the importance of estrogen, how it impacts our body, and the effects of having too much or too little can have on your health. You'll also learn ways to support your body's estrogen production, such as seed cycling, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, and even by having more orgasms.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 3: The Thyroid
programme.desc: How common are thyroid conditions? Women are 5 to 8 times more likely than a man to develop thyroid disease. If your thyroid isn't functioning optimally, every single cell in your body will feel it, including your ovaries. A thyroid function that is too high or too low can lead to symptoms that include low heart rate, fatigue, weight loss, and menstrual irregularities.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 4: Progesterone
programme.desc: When it comes to having a calm, chilled-out mindset or the sweet feelings of love, you can thank progesterone. On the flip side, suboptimal levels of this hormone can cause you to have headaches, breast tenderness, inability to fall asleep, and painful or heavy periods. Together, we'll learn what you can do to get your body producing the right amount of progesterone. Because this hormone is everything when it comes to feeling at peace.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 9: Detoxification
programme.desc: Did you know that 80,000 toxic chemicals have been released into the environment since the Industrial Revolution? What's worse is that very few have been tested for their long-term impact on human health. Today's session is all about detoxification, the natural process that our liver, kidneys, lungs, lymphatic system, gut, and skin perform daily to get rid of metabolic byproducts that our body produces and toxins that are absorbed from the environment. You'll learn how to avoid toxins and how to address those that you already are carrying due to the nature of the environment, as well as how to optimize your body's ability to detoxify.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 5: Heart Health

programme.desc: Today we will ask the tough questions necessary to connect you with the unique driving force in your life. The things about purpose is that it’s almost never about isolation. We find and fulfill our purpose by connecting with and serving others.

This program is here to remind you of a key universal principle: Only love is real.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: This is Your Spine on Yoga
programme.desc: Apply everything you've learned so far in this well-rounded sequence of twists, folds, and heart openers. Some points to remember: Lengthen the spine out of the pelvis before back bending, focus your twists toward the thoracic spine (the middle twelve vertebrae—not your neck or lower back), and discover the essence of a back bend in every forward fold.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Shoulder & Wrist Mobility
programme.desc: Did you know you can floss your shoulder blades? You’ll earn the fundamentals of good shoulder health—including what's your scapula and what it does—in this arm-focused class. You’ll begin by warming the shoulders and opening the front of the chest, followed by exercises to strengthen and align the wrists.

programme.desc: Explore your newfound spaciousness in this shoulder lovin' class. Waste no time waking up the wrists, then move through variations of Low Lunge (Anjaneyasana) with Cactus Arms before building to Side Plank (Vasisthasana). Counter those actions with Eagle Arms for a deep stretch across the upper back and some seated twisting.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 1: Health Care vs. Sick Care
programme.desc: Today, we talk about a revolutionary approach to health called Functional Medicine, and how you can have a healthy doctor-patient relationship.

programme.title: Breath, Body, Beats with Schuyler Grant - Breath, Body, Beats with Schuyler Grant - Day 3: Creating a Powerful Foundation of Flow
programme.desc: Flow is defined as an optimal state of consciousness where we feel our best and perform our best. Also known as “the zone,” this is the mental state in which you are fully immersed in whatever activity you’re doing as you’re doing it, with an energized focus. There’s a pleasurable sense of full engagement in the present moment. When you are so completely absorbed in what you are doing that you lose your sense of space and time. This could also be called mediation in motion. Effortless effort. Vinyasa style yoga is the most direct conduit Schuyler has found to dropping into the flow state. Today, you’ll work with your hands and feet—these areas are imperative in creating a powerful foundation for this challenge and your practice as a whole. Today’s class includes wrist stretches, rolling planks, and illuminating block work designed to increase strength and flexibility.

programme.title: Breath, Body, Beats with Schuyler Grant - Breath, Body, Beats with Schuyler Grant - Day 4: Opening the Hips
programme.desc: When an artist is so fully absorbed in the act of creation, hours can go by in what feels like an instant. When you’re so focused on your hands and your feet and the metronome of your breath coordinating them through postures, there may be no space in your brain for anything else except the here, the now, the present moment. This is dropping into flow. Many yogis crave hip-opening because activating and stretching the lower torso, considered to be the seat of our emotional consciousness, can be deeply transformative. In these moments, you may find the flow state more accessible— if you’re so consumed with sensation that your mind can’t be anywhere else. Use these hip-openers as a gateway into the present moment, rolling through Garland Pose (Malasana), Lizard Lunges (Utthan Pristhasana), and Modified Side Plank (Vasisthasana).

programme.title: Breath, Body, Beats with Schuyler Grant - Breath, Body, Beats with Schuyler Grant - Day 5: Testing Your Twist
programme.desc: Physical sensation can be a powerful way into the flow state. You may find it harder to breathe in twisting poses; but by elongating the spine and extending upward, you can reap the benefits of the powerful postures in today’s sequence while still maintaining the breath. Practice the essentials of twisting through lunges (Anjaneyasana), Monkey Pose (Hanumanasana), and various side stretches with ample focus on the connection between the breath, the waist, and the spine.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 3: The 3 Minds NEW
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 1
programme.desc: This class primarily focuses on increasing the flexibility and suppleness of your cervical spine (the top 7 vertebrae, otherwise known as your neck). We tend to neglect the neck when we practice/train. It has the tendency to be stiff and weak. So, before we practice some strength building mobility work in the next class, let's stretch it out and create some more space in the areas that tend to hold tension. Get your strap out and get ready for some yummy, feel-good stretches that lengthen the tissues of your neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 2
programme.desc: Now that we've stretched out our necks and created some space in this area, let's add some mobility work to the mix. Most of us tend to focus on strengthening bigger muscles and more obvious joints like our shoulders and hips, and our neck tends to get left out and neglected. This class is all about strengthening the neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Day 1
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Day 2
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Day 4
programme.desc: Bring a clear intention to your practice today, looking inward to ask: How would I like to take a stand in the world? Qigong offers a safe, supportive way to place your attention on the intention of being lit by the light of the sun. That is, moving in the world with clear direction, lightness, and heart-led purpose.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 2: Adrenal Glands
programme.desc: This sentence sums it up: The adrenal glands are the foundation of hormone balancing. If your adrenals aren't functioning at full capacity, you'll feel it. In today's lesson, we take a deep dive into the hormones that our adrenal glands produce. We'll start to get an idea of why taking care of and keeping these glands happy is so important.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 5: Estrogen
programme.desc: You can thank estrogen for keeping your lips full and plump and your body curvy. Today, we take a deep dive into the importance of estrogen, how it impacts our body, and the effects of having too much or too little can have on your health. You'll also learn ways to support your body's estrogen production, such as seed cycling, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, and even by having more orgasms.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 4: Progesterone
programme.desc: When it comes to having a calm, chilled-out mindset or the sweet feelings of love, you can thank progesterone. On the flip side, suboptimal levels of this hormone can cause you to have headaches, breast tenderness, inability to fall asleep, and painful or heavy periods. Together, we'll learn what you can do to get your body producing the right amount of progesterone. Because this hormone is everything when it comes to feeling at peace.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - This Is Why You 'Can’t Lose Weight'
programme.desc: The media tells you, 'Don’t worry! You’re big and you’re beautiful.' That you are healthy at any size. Nice to hear, but it simply isn’t true. Pharma companies and many in the medical community are now going to tell you it’s genetic — a disease of the brain that results in an insatiable hunger. They do this because surgeries and weight loss drugs are profitable. In this lesson, we will address these issues one by one.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Calories: Everything You Need to Know
programme.desc: Let’s use a quick analogy: If your body is a car, then reverse is actively gaining weight, neutral is not gaining or losing, and drive is weight loss… Ultimately you have been eating more than you are burning, which is what put the weight on in the first place. By controlling the calories in, we generally shift the car from reverse to neutral. No longer gaining, but not really losing a ton. By adding exercise into the mix we throw the car into drive without compromising your metabolism or muscle mass.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Body Fat: Why and How It Accumulates in Excess and What We Can Do About It
programme.desc: This lesson is the 101 on all things 'body fat' — what it actually is, what it does in and for the body, and what is considered a healthy body fat percentage. And, most importantly – for your purposes – how does it build up or, rather, get stored in the body and, conversely, how does it get released or “burned” off? Don’t worry, we aren’t going down a biochemistry rabbit hole here. These are just the must-know essentials.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Relevance of Macros & Micros
programme.desc: At long last you have arrived at the diet section of this course. And while technically this episode is about food quality, this is where Jillian answers all your questions about popular fad diets. Keto, Carnivore, Paleo, Pegan, Vegan, Vegetarian, Low Fat, Intermittent Fasting, Low Glycemic. Which is best?! Find out what matters most for weight loss.

programme.title: Peace of Mind Parenting - Peace of Mind Parenting - Day 1: Positive Parenting in a Pandemic
programme.desc: Today, you'll learn solutions to this work, life, and parenting balancing problem many of us are experiencing during this pandemic. programme.title: Peace of Mind Parenting - Peace of Mind Parenting - Day 2: What to Do When Your Child is Stressed
programme.desc: Today, we shift our thinking. We view these behaviors not as a problem but as communication. Your child’s behavior is actually communication. programme.title: Peace of Mind Parenting - Peace of Mind Parenting - Day 3: What to Do When YOU Are Stressed
programme.desc: It's important that we as parents know how to deal with stress, which is the focus of today's lesson. When you manage your own stress, you're better able to connect with your children in these challenging moments, and you can co-regulate with them so they feel calm and safe too.

programme.title: Tap Into Healing - Tap Into Healing: Releasing Overwhelm

In Day 1, we look at our health issues in body, mind, and spirit with open eyes, and start to clear out the overwhelm.

programme.title: Tap Into Healing - Tap Into Healing: Forgiveness

programme.title: Tap Into Healing - Tap Into Healing: Healthy Boundaries

programme.desc: Today, Jason’s getting vulnerable with you. He shares his personal story of how he was diagnosed with clinical depression and his journey into healing. His protocol includes supplements, new foods, meditation, and somatic therapy.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity - The Emerging Science of Longevity: Secrets to Healthy Aging
programme.desc: The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity - The Emerging Science of Longevity: Eating for Longevity
programme.desc: Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Twist What You Missed
programme.desc: This vinyasa class transforms the lessons from Day 6 into a series of playful asana. programme.desc: The shoulders are the seat of the neck. They influence the way it moves and positions itself in space. programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Flexion Section (Abdominals)
programme.desc: A strong stable core is truly the foundation for proper movement mechanics. Most of us are stuck in spinal extension. Our ribs flare out and our lower back is overly compressed. programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Side Body Strength
programme.desc: The oblique sling includes the internal and external obliques. This X pattern along the front and sides of our abdominal wall is an integral component of functional movement patterns. Most of us have too much strength in our back and not enough in our front and sides. This class serves as a remedy. Let's go.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Balancing Hormones for an Optimized Metabolism

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 190
programme.desc: This segment offers a dramatic contrast, featuring the international excellence and new launches from the Best of Sailing Boats at Genoa Boat Show 2025 alongside two high-performance American powerboats at MIBS: the massive, quint-engine HCB 56 Sueños GIX, a center console yacht with 3,000 HP and luxury amenities, and the versatile Pursuit S328 Sport, which perfectly balances serious offshore fishing with premium family cruising and comfort.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 191
programme.desc: The segment features three diverse luxury vessels: the long-range comfort of the Absolute Navetta 62 trawler yacht; the high-speed performance of the Mystic M4200 (PBIBS 2025) center console with raceboat heritage; and the elegant Sirena 48 Coupe (PBIBS 2025), an owner-operated yacht known for its efficient hull and open design.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 192
programme.desc: This episode is dedicated to performance and versatility, highlighting the 50-knot Italian maxi-RIB Mar.co E44 with its luxury cabin. It also covers three premier US fishing boats: the wide-beamed Southport 38 FE (PBIBS 2025), the serious offshore Bertram 39 CC (PBIBS 2025), and the versatile hybrid bay boat Blackfin 262 HB (MIBS 2025).

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 193
programme.desc: This episode covers Italian design and high performance, featuring the stylish Ranieri Sauvage 34 luxury RIB and the premier charter offerings of Spartivento. programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 194
programme.desc: This episode features the sleek De Antonio D60, a 60-foot Spanish yacht renowned for its clean deck and hidden outboards, alongside a look at the innovative Euthalia lightning protection system. Finally, it highlights the powerful, recently updated Robalo R300 CC (PBIBS 2025), a 30-foot center console built for serious offshore fishing with an aggressive Deep-V hull.

programme.desc: This episode features the luxury and speed of the Celebration for the 40th anniversary of Pershing in Capri, alongside the superyacht prowess of Heesen Yachts' Agnetha, a 55-meter yacht with a 4,500 NM range.
